name: Cameron D. Thomas
affiliation: Department of Clinical & Administrative Pharmacy · University of Georgia College of Pharmacy
short_bio: Dr. Thomas is a clinician-scientist developing data-driven approaches to individualize medication therapy and improve patient safety.
bio_html:
Dr. Cameron D. Thomas develops precision-medicine approaches that integrate pharmacogenomics, clinical data, and computational methods to improve medication selection, safety, and patient outcomes.

His research program connects cardiovascular pharmacotherapy and real-world evidence with artificial intelligence and natural language processing, with an emphasis on clinically meaningful translation.
research_statement: My research focuses on clinically grounded precision therapeutics: identifying how genetic variation, treatment context, and real-world clinical data can be integrated to improve medication selection, effectiveness, and safety. The lab uses pharmacogenomics, cardiovascular pharmacotherapy, clinical NLP, and transparent computational methods to generate evidence that can translate into patient care.
